scenarios.name: Hero Section Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays the value proposition, headline, and CTAs correctly with proper responsive behavior

steps.description: Mount the HeroSection component in isolation
steps.context: Component should render without errors using React Testing Library

steps.description: Check that a clear headline describing the product value is displayed
steps.context: REQ-1: Display hero section with headline and value proposition

steps.description: Confirm supporting description paragraph explains core benefits
steps.context: Content should be visible above the fold on desktop

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' button is present and prominent
steps.context: REQ-10: Primary CTA should link to /register

steps.description: Check that 'Log In' button is present as secondary action
steps.context: REQ-10: Secondary CTA should link to /login

test_cases.expected: Component renders without throwing errors
Headline contains product value proposition text (e.g., 'Shorten URLs', 'URL Shortener')
Description text explains benefits of URL shortening service
Button is present with role='button' or as link element

test_cases.input: Click 'Get Started' button and check navigation
test_cases.expected: Navigation to /register route is triggered
Secondary login button is present and visually distinct from primary

test_cases.input: Click 'Log In' button and check navigation
test_cases.expected: Navigation to /login route is triggered
Layout adjusts to stacked/vertical arrangement
Layout displays side-by-side arrangement

test_cases.input: Check headline uses gradient text styling
test_cases.expected: Headline has gradient CSS classes applied (primary -> secondary colors)

scenarios.name: Features Section Display

steps.context: REQ-2: Present features section showcasing 3 key product capabilities

steps.description: Confirm exactly 3 feature cards are displayed
steps.context: Features: URL shortening, analytics, link management

steps.description: Check first feature displays URL shortening capability
steps.context: Icon: Link, Description about creating short URLs

steps.description: Check second feature displays analytics capability
steps.context: Icon: Chart, Description about tracking and statistics

steps.description: Check third feature displays link management capability
steps.context: Icon: Grid, Description about organizing URLs

test_cases.expected: Component renders without throwing errors
Exactly 3 feature cards are present in the DOM

test_cases.input: Query for URL Shortening feature title
test_cases.expected: Feature card contains 'URL Shortening' or similar text

test_cases.input: Query for URL Shortening feature description
test_cases.expected: Description mentions creating short/memorable URLs
Feature card contains 'Analytics' or 'Dashboard' text
Description mentions tracking clicks/statistics/referrers

test_cases.input: Query for Link Management feature title
test_cases.expected: Feature card contains 'Link Management' or similar text

test_cases.input: Query for Link Management feature description
test_cases.expected: Description mentions organizing/managing URLs
Each feature card contains an icon element (SVG or icon component)
Feature cards have glass-effect CSS classes (backdrop-blur, bg-opacity)
Features display in single column layout
Features display in 3-column grid layout

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Perform automated accessibility testing on rendered homepage
steps.context: NFR-1: Achieve WCAG 2.1 AA compliance

steps.description: Test that all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
steps.context: US-6: Keyboard Navigation for screen reader users

steps.description: Check appropriate ARIA labels on interactive elements and landmarks
steps.context: NFR-4: Include appropriate ARIA labels

steps.description: Check visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
steps.context: Accessibility requirement for visual focus indication

test_cases.expected: No critical or serious accessibility violations
All buttons and links receive focus in logical order
Focus ring/outline visible on focused elements
main and contentinfo landmarks present
Decorative icons marked with aria-hidden='true'
All buttons have text content or aria-label
All links have descriptive text content
Text meets WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large)
First Tab focuses skip link, Enter activates it, focus moves to main
Headings follow logical order (h1 -> h2 -> h3), no skipped levels
